text: この　あたりは　なわばり　だって　いったろ！

structure.jp: この　あたりは　なわばり　だって
structure.en: that this area is our turf

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.span: なわばり　だって　いったろ
patterns.explanation: って is the casual form of と, which shows what was said. なわばり　だって　いった = 'said that it's our turf'.

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.explanation: たろ is a rough, shortened ただろう, pushing the listener to agree. いったろ = 'I told you, didn't I'.
